notes: Installed Tremolo and Docklands Pass but never a breaker for Starlit Knight; from T8 to T16 ran HQ 3-4 times a turn through Starlit Knight/Congratulations! re-accessing the same Flood the Market/Piranhas/Oppo Research, ate dozens of tags, and on T14-T16 spent 11 clicks running into ETR Starlit Knight with 0 credits. It never contested Server 4, where Stoke the Embers was scored T11 and T14 and Tomorrow's Headline won the game on T17.

Solid Leech/HQ pressure stole Hybrid Release and Project Yagi-Uda on T4, and it won on T10 via Sericulture Expansion steals. Minor issues: T2 drew and clicked for credits at 13 credits instead of running, T7 facechecked Diviner without a breaker, and T9 pumped Utae to 3 against Diviner but still didn't break it.

After stealing Next Big Thing on T4 it clicked for credits nearly every click from T5 to T18 and hoarded 43 credits with no plan. On T13 it would not pay 1 credit to Paywall on Server 2, and it never ran Server 2 again while Oracle Thinktank (T14), Artificial Cryptocrash (T17) and Remastered Edition (T19) were advanced and scored there.

Paid 3 credits per Utae break to run HQ through Diviner on T3-T7 and repeatedly saw the same La Costa Grid/Tatu-Bola, draining its economy. It often pumped Utae without breaking (T10, T12, T13, T14), taking net damage for nothing, and T16 pumped Rising Tide once and gave up on Hafrún. It ran HQ instead of Server 1 on T11 and T13, so Sericulture Expansion was scored there twice.

Won through Nyusha R&D pressure (Freedom of Information x2) and Server 1 steals of Stoke the Embers and Post-Truth Dividend, but its economy ran near 0 all game. T2 Jailbreak into unrezzed ice at 1 credit and T4 Tread Lightly into Server 1 at 2 credits were pointless facechecks. It knowingly took 3 net damage from Doomscroll twice (T6, T10), and T7-T8 were passive while Witch Hunt was advanced and scored on T9.

After stealing Project Yagi-Uda on T4 and accessing Urtica Cipher on T8, it clicked for credits every click from T9 to T24 and ended with 77 unused credits. Meanwhile the Corp scored Sericulture Expansion (T10), Hybrid Release three times (T20, T23, T24) and Project Yagi-Uda (T25) from servers it never ran.

Good R&D pressure through Funhouse with Telework Contract and Creative Commission for money; it won on T9 after stealing Oracle Thinktank x2, Kingmaking, Artificial Cryptocrash and Remastered Edition. Minor oddities: Living Mural went onto Capacitor (T4) even though Gauss already broke it, and it let tags pile up from Funhouse.

Installed only Unity and Daily Casts, and after bouncing off Capacitor on T7 it clicked for credits every turn up to 42 credits with a full grip, never installing a breaker. Server 3, behind a single Capacitor, went unchallenged while Remastered Edition (T8), Artificial Cryptocrash (T10) and Kingmaking (T12) were scored there.

Ran open R&D eight times on T1-T2 but ignored Server 1, letting Longevity Serum (T2) and Hybrid Release (T4) score from it. From T5 to T16 it only clicked for credits (61 credits by the end) and installed just Abaasy on T12. Longevity Serum (T12), Hybrid Release (T13) and Lotus Haze (T17) were scored from remotes it never ran.

Won on T13 with good HQ/remote pressure (Lotus Haze, See How They Run, Hybrid Release x2, Chastushka sabotage). It did miss obvious steals of naked Mitosis remotes: it skipped the 3-counter Server 2 on T2 (Regenesis scored T3) and the 2-counter Server 5 on T5 (Longevity Serum scored T6), running R&D instead.

Won on T14 through steady R&D pressure past Bathynomus plus HQ/Archives steals, which was a sensible plan. However its economy hovered at 0-2 credits for most of the game, so it spent many clicks on single credits, and the T3 run into Server 2 cost 3 cards to Anemone and Mavirus.

Won on T11 by stealing Kingmaking from Server 1 and Next Big Thing and Remastered Edition from R&D. It reinstalled Gauss three times and ran HQ into the known F2P on T7, losing Gauss again just to re-see Tiered Subscription. It also took a Funhouse tag every R&D run, spending clicks and credits on tag removal.

Clicked for credits T4-T8 up to 22 credits with a full grip instead of running, then had a strong T9 Finality R&D dig. On T9 and T10 it ran Server 2 into Anemone, took the net damage, then jacked out with nothing gained. On T11, with an Esa core-damage-reduced grip, it emptied its hand on Mavirus/Urtica Cipher, then stole Hybrid Release from HQ with 0 cards and was flatlined by Personal Evolution, an avoidable loss.

A strong T1-T4 Sang Kancil rush got it to 6 points, but then it took 22 turns to find one more agenda. It sat at 0-4 credits removing tags for many turns, made Ping (T7) and N-Pot/Loot Box (T14, T16) facechecks without breakers, and played passive credit turns (T12, T20, T24, T25) while Freedom of Information was scored T13 and T24. It finally won on T26 through Server 1 with Tremolo, Afterimage and Sang Kancil.

Fast, focused R&D pressure through Congratulations! won on T6 (Post-Truth Dividend, Freedom of Information, Stoke the Embers, Witch Hunt). Small issues: Carmen for 5 on T1, and facechecks of HQ (N-Pot, T2, 3 credits) and Server 1 (Ping, T5) with no matching breaker.

Good early R&D runs reached 5 points by T2 (Fujii Asset Retrieval, Sericulture Expansion), but after T7 it only clicked for credits (24 by T11). R&D's ice never rezzed and Server 1 grew advancement counters, yet it never installed a fracter for Tatu-Bola. Flower Sermon (T10) and Project Yagi-Uda (T12) were scored from Server 1 for the loss.

Efficient central pressure stole Artificial Cryptocrash x2 and Remastered Edition, then it paid through Grubber on T7 to steal Oracle Thinktank and win. The only waste was the F2P bounce of Gauss on T4 and clicking for credits on T3.

Never ran, installed nothing, and clicked for credits every click from T1 to T16, ending on 71 credits. The Corp freely scored Hybrid Release (T3, T10), Sericulture Expansion (T5, installed T4), Flower Sermon (T15) and Fujii Asset Retrieval (T17, installed T16).

Aggressively contested Server 1 with Odore through Karunā and won on T7 with steals of Fujii Asset Retrieval, Project Yagi-Uda x2 and Hybrid Release. On T5 it facechecked HQ (Diviner) at 3 credits, and on T6 it chose to continue through Karunā on R&D, losing 4 cards for an empty access.

Won on T19 with steals of Remastered Edition, Next Big Thing, Oracle Thinktank and Kingmaking, but it had long passive stretches (T1-T3 and T8-T11 clicking credits up to 21 without running). Running R&D through Funhouse and paying to clear tags on T13-T17 drained it to 0, so it couldn't contest Server 3 before Remastered Edition was scored on T18.
